messages:
alice.dev: Kicking off green deploy for v3.2.0 to the 'green' router pool at 18:20 PT. Plan is pause-and-probe: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with probes at each step. 15m quiet window between major bumps. @ryan.ops @sara.prod please ack and watch latency dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alice.dev: release=v3.2.0 target=green pool. CI checks passed.

ryan.ops: Ack. I'll open a short quiet window on infra timeline and pre-warm the green edge. Will monitor 95th pct latency and 5xx rate.

sara.prod: Ack. I'll pin the canary alert to the 'green-probe' rule and watch apples-to-apples error budget. If errors > 0.5% for 5m, we rollback.

alice.dev: Quick probe checks:
- health endpoints should be green
- session stickiness preserved (cookie header test)
- no regressions in streaming timeouts

mo_ops: On standby for rapid weight revert. Revert command if we see spike: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"pool":"green","weight":0,"pool":"blue","weight":100}'`

ryan.ops: Also pre-apply a routing tag pin for a small cohort so we can trace user journeys: `rbctl tag create trace-cohort --size=200` then `rbctl route add --tag trace-cohort --pool green`

alice.dev: If probe looks good at 10% (5m), we'll bump to 50% and hold 15m. Final 100% only after 50% hold shows stable latency and no error regressions.

sara.prod: Noted. I'm running a short smoke-run against the green pool now and will post a quick summary in 5m.

deploy-bot: Health-checks: all endpoints ok on green (startup checks passed).

alice.dev: If anyone sees anomalies during probe, call it in this thread and @mo_ops will execute immediate rollback. Keep messages short — we want to surface issues fast. :thumbsup:

ryan.ops: Watching logs and tailing router metrics. Will post if >2x baseline latency or any 5xx bursts.

sara.prod: Smoke-run looks clean: no 5xx, median latency +3ms. Proceeding with 10% cutover when the clock hits 18:20 PT.

alice.dev: Thanks — cutting 10% now. Will post updates after probe window.
